summary: Saving a decoded canonical tag as a local record fails because required product and color name are blank.
claim: Saving a decoded canonical tag as a local record fails because required product and color name are blank.

evidence.source: MainViewModel.decodedSeed() returns CustomSeed with product = text("subtype") (empty for canonical OpenSpool records) and color = "" always. Filament.kt validateRecord() requires brand, material, product, and colorName to be non-blank. CustomDialog pre-populates these blanks, and saveCustom will set an error, preventing save.

suggested_remediation: Make color name and/or product optional for custom records or derive a safe default while preserving original tag fields; do not block save on missing label-only fields.
suggested_validation: Read a canonical tag, tap 'Edit as a local record', then save with only brand, type, color_hex, diameter, and weight populated. Verify the record saves and product/colorName are optionally blank or defaulted without validation error.
